audit.why: Ice Shard is 725 range on 7s dropping to 3s, Ring of Frost roots at 450 — both outside Galio's 275 taunt and 650 dash — so she owns levels 1 through first item. The turn is two items, when Hero's Entrance makes range irrelevant, exactly as the content layer and packet.levelChart already said.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.spikes named no Lissandra spike at all and treated first item as a Galio spike, contradicting the chart.
audit.why: Her spike is level 6 Frozen Tomb (120s at rank 1) which invalidates a Galio commit outright; his is two items, where R closes the range she has held all lane.

audit.whatIsWrong: The single most important interaction was absent: Frozen Tomb self-cast makes her untargetable AND heals her, so a Shield of Durand taunt or a Hero's Entrance knockup spent into it does nothing and comes back on an 18s or 140s+ cooldown. Also absent: Ring of Frost roots at 450 range, which is outside the 275 Galio needs to taunt — she roots first every time.
audit.why: Riot R text: 'If cast on Lissandra, she encases herself in dark ice, healing herself while becoming untargetable and invulnerable.' Riot W text: root, 450 range. Galio W range 275.

audit.corrected: Rewrote with Glacial Path 24s to 12s, Ring of Frost 10s at 450, Frozen Tomb 120s, plus explicit 'E in once Ring of Frost is down' sequencing in tradeGood and dosFull[1].d.

audit.whatIsWrong: No mention of Grievous Wounds anywhere despite Frozen Tomb healing her.
audit.why: Riot R text explicitly heals on self-cast; extended trades are decided by whether that heal lands.
